project.name: Prunus Mume - Backend Integration
project.instruction: Connect the completed Meiwen frontend to the real backend. Replace the data and identity layers only. Do not redesign the UI, expand the business scope, or rewrite completed components without a concrete integration requirement.

references: Current project implementation after Stages 1, 2, and 3
sourceOfTruth: Use opendesign-prompt-client.json as the sole source of truth for endpoints, request fields, response fields, pagination shapes, authentication behavior, VIP rules, and payment exceptions.
objective: Replace structured frontend mocks with real API calls while preserving the completed user experience and visual design.
preImplementationTask: Before modifying data access, produce a concise mapping of every current mock module to its corresponding backend endpoint.
Replace mocks page by page instead of performing a large component rewrite.
Identify any specification mismatch before making assumptions.

requirements: Configure the API base URL through an environment variable. Do not hard-code a backend host.
Create a shared API client for the standard response envelope: { code, data, message }.
Treat every non-success code as an error and surface the backend message to the user.
Handle request cancellation or stale responses where search and filtering can issue overlapping requests.
Keep API response types explicit and close to the source specification.

authentication.mechanism: Sa-Token session authentication using the default token name satoken
requirements: Support cookie-based sessions and send credentials when cross-origin configuration requires it.
If the backend returns satoken through an accessible response header instead of a cookie, capture and persist it safely according to the backend deployment mode.
Implement current-user loading, protected routes, login restoration after refresh, and logout.
Redirect or guide signed-out users appropriately without losing their intended return route.
Do not implement a second authentication system.

dataIntegration: Replace mock data with the real endpoints for question-bank search and detail.
Replace mock data with the real endpoints for question search and detail.
Connect favourite status, favourite count, add favourite, and remove favourite.
Connect like status, like count, add like, and remove like.
Connect contribution creation, listing, editing, and deletion.
Connect today's sign-in state, sign-in action, monthly count, and monthly sign-in records.
Connect current-user profile loading and editing, public profile loading, and password change.
Connect membership order creation and the payment flow.
Keep a clearly named development mock switch only when it is necessary for local demonstration. Never mix mock and real data silently.
pagination: Normalize list responses shaped as { records, total, size, current } when they appear under data.
Use the existing shared pagination UI and preserve filters while changing pages.
Reset to the first page when a filter change invalidates the current page.
vipRules: When needVip is true and the current user is not an active VIP, the frontend must not render or expose the raw answer.
Treat userRole 2 as VIP and honor vipExpireTime when the backend provides it.
Keep the existing upgrade UI and route non-members to /membership.
avatarUpload: Upload the file directly using the returned credentials.
Update the profile only after confirmation returns the final avatar URL.
Provide upload progress, failure, retry, and successful-preview states.
paymentRules: Create the membership order with POST /alipay/submit.
Navigate the browser to /alipay/pay/{outTradeNo} as a full-page navigation.
Treat /alipay/pay/{outTradeNo} and /alipay/return as HTML navigation endpoints, not JSON APIs.
Never fetch the payment HTML through XHR or the shared JSON API client.
securityAndScope: Never call an endpoint whose path or controller starts with Internal or /internal.
Do not expose private user fields on public profile pages.
Do not expose VIP answers in rendered HTML, serialized page state, or client-side mock fallbacks for unauthorized users.
Do not add new backend endpoints or features outside the source specification.
stateHandling: Preserve the completed loading, empty, validation, error, confirmation, and success interfaces.
Replace mock transitions with authoritative server responses.
Use optimistic updates only where rollback behavior is clear, such as like or favourite toggles.
Prevent duplicate submissions for sign-in, contribution forms, profile saving, and membership order creation.
acceptanceCriteria: A successful login survives refresh and logout removes access to protected pages.
Question-bank search, question search, pagination, favourites, likes, contributions, sign-in, profile editing, and membership order creation call the specified real endpoints.
Backend error messages are visible to the user and failures never occur silently.
Unauthorized users cannot access VIP answers.
Payment uses full-page navigation rather than fetch or XHR.
The UI remains visually consistent with the pre-integration version.
The project passes TypeScript, lint, build, and updated application tests.
